AMENDMENT NO. 6 OFFERED BY MR . FINE 
The Acting CHAIR. It is now in order 
to consider amendment No. 6 printed in 
part A of House Report 119–749. 
Mr. FINE. Mr. Chair, I have an 
amendment at the desk. 
The Acting CHAIR. The Clerk will 
designate the amendment. 
The text of the amendment is as fol-
lows: 
Page 42, strike line 6 through line 10. 


The Acting CHAIR (Ms. K
ING-HINDS). 
The question is on the amendment of-
fered by the gentleman from Florida 
(Mr. F
INE). 
The question was taken; and the Act-
ing Chair announced that the ayes ap-
peared to have it. 
Ms. LOIS FRANKEL of Florida. 
Madam Chair, I demand a recorded 
vote. 
The Acting CHAIR. Pursuant to 
clause 6 of rule XVIII, further pro-
ceedings on the amendment offered by 
the gentleman from Florida will be 
postponed.
